subject: Run-rate to reserve bridge — MaplePay usage snapshot & proposal
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@maplepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Run-rate to reserve bridge — MaplePay usage snapshot & proposal

Hi Elena —

Quick follow-up from our QBR: I pulled a short snapshot of your token consumption for the past 90 days and sketched a bridge from your current run-rate to a 12-month reserved plan that should lower per-token cost while keeping headroom for seasonal spikes. Attachment: MaplePay_Q2_token_report.csv (token-by-route, p95 latencies).

Key observations:
- Average run-rate (last 60 days): ~6.4M tokens / month
- Recent feature launch added a recurrent +18% weekly delta on inference traffic
- p95 steady at 350–420ms on the hosted endpoint; tail spikes are tied to longer context sessions

Proposal (high level):
- 12-month reserved: 8M tokens / month baseline (saves ~23% vs run-rate)
- Burst credits: 2M tokens/month banked for seasonal peaks
- Auto-fallback to standard-tier models if we hit >110% sustained for 7 days (protects latency SLAs)

If this looks reasonable I can run a price breakdown and impact to your monthly burn (Ben will add a short ROI table). If Procurement needs a one-pager, I can attach a mutual action plan and DocuSign link.

Next step: would you prefer Ben and I share the detailed cost table or jump to a short procurement-ready proposal?

Thanks,
Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@maplepay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@maplepay.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Run-rate to reserve bridge — MaplePay usage snapshot & proposal

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the summary and the CSV — looked through the major routes. A couple of clarifying Qs before we move pricing to procurement:
1) How are overage charges handled if we blow past the 8M/month baseline? Any per-token surcharge caps?
2) Can you show a side-by-side of current monthly cost (hosted on pay-as-you-go) vs the reserved option including burst credits?
3) We care about end-user latency — if the fallback to standard-tier models is triggered, how do you ensure latency stays within our SLA?

Procurement is looped; they prefer a single PDF with: summary, pricing table, SLA bullets, and a short M.A.P. (mutual action plan). We have internal signatures needed by 6/18.

Elena
Elena Rossi
VP Product, MaplePay
elena.rossi@maplepay.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Run-rate to reserve bridge — internal calc

Laura —

I looked at the CSV and sketched a price breakdown. Key points to include for Procurement:
- Baseline pricing: 8M reserved tokens/month @ $0.0026/token (equivalent effective rate)
- Burst credits: 2M tokens/month included; overage beyond baseline + burst = $0.0031/token (capped at 20% above baseline rate)
- Annual commitment discount applied if customer signs 12-month term upfront (we included in the $0.0026 rate)

Quick ROI table to paste into the doc:
- Current avg monthly spend (pay-as-you-go): ~$20,800
- Proposed reserved monthly (8M + pro-rated burst): ~$16,640
- Estimated monthly savings: ~$4,160 (~20%) — conservative estimate, assumes current feature growth continues

Latency / SLA note: fallback path uses a validated model variant that is quantized and routed to dedicated burst pools; we recommend a canary period of 2 weeks to monitor p95. If we see sustained p95 delta >100ms, automatic rollback and a credit guardrail is triggered (we can add that language into the SLA bullets).

I'm attaching the detailed price sheet (reserve-pricing-breakdown.xlsx) and a short M.A.P. we can drop into the PDF.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Elena / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached: a consolidated one-page with the ROI table, SLA bullets, and the mutual action plan; also included Ben's pricing sheet. Files: MaplePay_Q2_token_report.csv, reserve-pricing-breakdown.xlsx, MaplePay_request_form.pdf

Highlights:
- Proposed term: 12 months, 8M tokens/month reserved, 2M burst credits/month
- Effective rate: $0.0026/token with a capped overage of $0.0031/token (capped at +20%)
- SLA: p95 latency target 350ms; canary monitoring for two weeks post-rollout with automated rollback and credit if degradation >100ms sustained 7-day window
- Implementation: 7 business days to provision dedicated routing + a two-week monitoring window

DocuSign link (procurement-friendly): https://app.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
HubSpot record for this deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/MP-2027

Laura
